manifest.name: @jaychang1989/dsh-webchat
manifest.description: Opens the official DeepSeek web app (chat.deepseek.com) inside DeepSeek Harness: one sidebar entry renders the real page in the center column, through the same native browser guest the built-in side-card browser uses. No chat UI, no agent tools, no runtime dependencies.
manifest.author: jaychang1989

bundle.text:
# dsh-webchat bundle patch: inserts the dual-face plugin row into a profile
# roster. Applied as a profile bundle layer (the `dsh.bundle.patch` manifest
# field) over dsh-base; activate by adding this package to the profile's
# `dsh.profile.bundles`, or with
#   dsh plugin --profile <name> add @jaychang1989/dsh-webchat
#   dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:jaychang1989/dsh-webchat
#
# The row is a bare plugin by package name: the node half (exports ".") runs in
# the host process — it registers the two /api/dsh-webchat routes and opens the
# page in a window — and the `dsh.client` declaration in package.json makes the
# browser half (exports "./client", served at /plugins/<id>/client.js) load in
# the web GUI as the sidebar entry and its panel. `name` must be this package's
# manifest name verbatim (scoped names included) — dsh-client-modules keys every
# browser row by it, and lib/client.js registers its factory under the same id.
# `id` is the profile entry id; dsh >= 0.1.7 also uses it as the settings form
# namespace, so keep it stable. It must be unique per profile: a second package
# inserting the same `webchat` id cannot be installed alongside this one — the
# duplicate is rejected at boot.
- insert:
    - id: webchat
      name: '@jaychang1989/dsh-webchat'

readme.text: 在 [DeepSeek Harness Desktop](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 里打开 [chat.deepseek.com](https://chat.deepseek.com) 官方网页版：点侧边栏「Chat」，真实页面就渲染在 **DSH 窗口的中栏**里，和「自动化任务」那类整页视图一样。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @jaychang1989/dsh-webchat
```

或直接从仓库安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:jaychang1989/dsh-webchat
```

安装后**重启桌面端**。

- 再点一次入口收起面板；切换去别的面板（插件、自动化任务、会话……）时访客只是被隐藏、从不被卸载，所以切回来不会重新加载、也不会掉登录。
- 回复里的外链（引用、来源这类会弹新窗口的链接）现在交给**系统默认浏览器**打开——之前点了毫无反应。
- 桌面端给浏览器访客的分区是**进程内**的（每次运行随机命名），所以登录态由本插件自己保存：页面的 localStorage 与页面自己的 cookie 由页面侧搬运，分区 cookie（**含 HttpOnly**）在宿主能拿到 Electron 时一并搬运。宿主拿不到 Electron 时，前两条仍然生效。
- **想退出登录**：先完全退出 DSH，再删除登录快照。默认在 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-webchat\session.json`；设置了 `DSH_HOME` 环境变量时跟随它：`<DSH_HOME>\dsh-webchat\session.json`（旧快照只迁移一次，旧文件保留供备份，可手动删除；请保留不含登录信息的 `session.migrated` 标记，防止旧登录再次迁入）。
在 Chat 面板中按 **F5 或 Ctrl+R**（macOS 为 **⌘R**）刷新官方页面，即可更新其他设备新增的会话；无需重启应用，也没有额外的刷新按钮。快捷键可在宿主的快捷键设置中调整。

- 用户代理只移除 `Electron/<版本>` token、其余原样保留：既躲开站点对 "electron" 字样的「使用环境异常」弹窗，又不制造版本指纹失配（后者曾加重 WAF 验证循环与 Google 登录异常）。
- 登录恢复完成前暂停所有自动保存，恢复失败保留原有快照；仅在官方聊天网站读写页面登录信息，授权网站的 cookie 不进入快照。
- 自动保存时排除 AWS WAF 验证 cookie 和存储；恢复旧快照时跳过 WAF 存储。手动导入的 cookie 仍按原样恢复，但之后不会自动保存其中的 WAF cookie。
- DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 的部分环境无法提供 Electron cookie 接口：此时仍通过页面存储恢复登录，但无法保存或恢复 HttpOnly cookie。诊断接口 `/api/dsh-webchat/state` 的 `session.electron` 会报告可用性。
- 上述修复不能保证内嵌浏览器一定能通过站点验证；真实登录、Google 授权及重启恢复仍取决于宿主与站点行为。

- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2 或更新的 0.2.x**
- Node.js >= 22
- 桌面端（DSH Desktop）：只有它提供原生访客桥接；纯 `dsh web` 会走窗口降级

Opens the official [chat.deepseek.com](https://chat.deepseek.com) web app inside [DeepSeek Harness Desktop](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): click "Chat" in the sidebar and the real page renders in the **center column of the DSH window**, like any other full-page view.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @jaychang1989/dsh-webchat
```

Or straight from this repository:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:jaychang1989/dsh-webchat
```

**Restart the desktop app after installing.**

1. Click "Chat" in the sidebar — the page loads in the center column; there is no second click.
2. Sign in to DeepSeek once — **restarts will not ask again**.

- Clicking again collapses the panel. Switching to another panel (Plugins, Automation Tasks, a session …) only hides the guest, never unmounts it, so coming back neither reloads the page nor drops the session.
- External reply links (citations and sources that would open a new window) now open in the **system default browser** — before, clicking them did nothing.
- The shell hands every browser guest a **process-lifetime** partition (a fresh random name per run), so this plugin carries the session itself: the page's localStorage and its own cookies travel through the page, and the partition's cookies (**HttpOnly included**) travel through the host half wherever Electron is reachable. Without Electron, the first two still work.
- **To sign out**: fully quit DSH, then delete the snapshot file. It lives at `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-webchat\session.json` by default, or `<DSH_HOME>\dsh-webchat\session.json` when `DSH_HOME` is set. Legacy credentials are migrated once and the old file is retained for backup; it can be removed manually. Keep the credential-free `session.migrated` marker to prevent the old login from being imported again.

Press **F5 or Ctrl+R** (**⌘R** on macOS) while Chat is selected to refresh the official page and fetch conversations created on another device. No extra refresh button or app restart is needed. The bindings can be customized in the shell shortcut settings.

- The user agent only drops the `Electron/<version>` token; everything else passes through byte-for-byte. This dodges the site's literal "electron" substring check (the 使用环境异常 dialog) without the version-fingerprint mismatch that once worsened WAF challenges and Google sign-in.
- All automatic saves wait for login restoration and its reload to finish. Failed restoration preserves the previous snapshot. Page credentials are only accessed on the official chat origin, and OAuth-site cookies are excluded.
- Automatic snapshots exclude AWS WAF cookies and storage. Old WAF storage is skipped during restore. Explicitly imported cookies are still restored as supplied, but WAF cookies are not automatically saved afterwards.
- Some DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 environments expose no Electron cookie API. Page storage can still carry the login, but HttpOnly cookies cannot be saved or restored there. `/api/dsh-webchat/state` reports availability through `session.electron`.
- These fixes do not guarantee that an embedded browser passes site challenges. Real sign-in, Google authorization and restart survival still depend on the host and site.

- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2 or a newer 0.2.x**
- Node.js >= 22
- The desktop app: only it provides the native guest bridge; plain `dsh web` uses the window fallback
